label: Named in topographic-database team photograph, 1999
basis: Landlink Issue 8, May 1999, names Rob Parkin in its photograph of the team recognised for establishing the New Zealand Topographic Digital Database. The four-year project began at DOSLI in 1995.

sources.label: Landlink, Issue 8 (May 1999), page 1, “LINZ first in mapping” (scan provided by Nathan Heazlewood)
